name: b4_diff_scanner

phase_0.boundary_condition: the Belnap FOUR disagreement lattice over the input-class corpus between the front and back parser: every input lands in exactly one cell {N, T, F, B}, and the lattice closes when the verdicts reproduce the planted ground truth

VINIT.chosen_element: raw input-class byte stream before any component names it
VINIT.justification: the unparsed request is the void state; nothing has been named until a parser reads it

TANCH.chosen_element: the target parser pair (front proxy, origin)
TANCH.justification: the pair is the closed boundary that contains the whole scan; the scan means nothing outside this pair

AFWD.chosen_element: forwarding identical bytes to the front parser
AFWD.justification: directed transformation of the input toward its first parse; the T-arm morphism

AREV.chosen_element: reading the back parser's response back
AREV.justification: contravariant descent: the second parse returns from the component to the scanner; the F-arm morphism

CLINK.chosen_element: composition of per-input verdicts into the full disagreement lattice
CLINK.justification: sequential chaining: each input's B4 cell is linked into the one lattice that covers the whole corpus

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: μ∘δ=id self-verification against planted ground truth
IMSCRIB.justification: the scanner recognizes itself: its verdict lattice reproduces the planted memberships exactly, the stone that knows itself

FSPLIT.chosen_element: broadcast of one input to both components (front-arm, back-arm)
FSPLIT.justification: one byte stream branches into two distinct parse paths, exactly the co-multiplication δ

FFUSE.chosen_element: B4 classification oracle fusing the two parse views into one verdict cell
FFUSE.justification: the two views reconstitute the input's membership in the disagreement lattice; must equal the planted membership, exactly the multiplication μ

EVALT.chosen_element: agreement state T: both parsers accept and agree
EVALT.justification: affirmative: the composed system is consistent on this input

EVALF.chosen_element: agreement-on-rejection state F: both parsers reject identically
EVALF.justification: negative: the composed system consistently refuses this input

ENGAGR.chosen_element: dialetheic state B: one parser accepts, the other rejects, or parse views differ
ENGAGR.justification: a paradice held without resolution: the input is both accepted and rejected, and this both is the finding candidate

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only fixation of each B cell with its differential evidence pair

phase_2.split_element: broadcast of the input-class mutator to both parsers
phase_2.split_input: 9 differential classes → B, control → T, nonexistent → F, no N
split_outputs: front parse view of each class
back parse view of each class
phase_2.fuse_result: 9 differential classes → B, control → T, nonexistent → F, no N

phase_3.void_description: unparsed bytes before either component names them; no verdict exists
phase_3.true_description: both parsers accept and agree: the composed system is T
phase_3.false_description: both parsers reject identically: the composed system is F
phase_3.both_description: one parser accepts while the other rejects, or the parse views differ: the composed system is B, the dialetheic gap, held as a finding candidate

steps.domain_action: bind the target parser pair (front proxy, origin)
broadcast identical bytes to both components
forward the bytes to the front parser (T-arm)
read the back parser's response back (F-arm)
fuse the two parse views into the B4 cell for this input
compose all per-input cells into the disagreement lattice
hold the dialetheic B cells — finding candidates — without resolution
verify μ∘δ=id — the lattice reproduces the planted ground truth

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the mutator registry translating each input class into a byte-exact request
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: raw socket send/recv, byte-exact, no library normalization
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the B4 verdict table: one cell per input class
phase_5.alfs_store: BOUNTY_PLAYBOOK_VULN_HUNTING_2026.md plus the parity_testbed.py planted ground truth

phase_6.cycle_cost: one byte-exact request/response round-trip pair per input class
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the input's B4 cell in the disagreement lattice
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — verdicts are deterministic functions of the bytes and the parse models; the scan creates no new uncertainty, it only locates the uncertainty the parsers already hold

banked_count_check.verdict: 1 unit(s) survived a clear by being banked in a frame (1 live clear(s))
